summary:
Scope: the live receiver cutover from Host 0.8.0 to 0.9.0 under supervisor, as a pattern. Source of the Host commands and the single-writer service lock: the cited Program.fs and receiver reference; the existing contract/telemetry-host and github/home-utel-receiver-host-0-8-state records give earlier Host state. Live paths, hashes and versions are operational facts to refresh, not recorded here.

Pattern that held: stage the new payload beside the old one by verified extraction of the published package and re-hash every file; run the new Host's read-only status against the live configuration before touching anything (both stores read identically, no lock needed); stop only the receiver's supervisor program (the container and its ssh stay up); seal both store directories and the supervisor configuration with a preserving copy while it is stopped; run the new Host's preflight on the live configuration; switch only the program path in the supervisor configuration; reread and update; then verify controls (the other store and the old spool byte-identical, the live configuration untouched, no-auth health 401, an authenticated health ready, a browser login and snapshot, unattended drain still succeeding). Outage was under half a minute. Nothing is written by the new Host until the first batch of the new kind.

Rollback boundary: before any new-kind batch, rollback is restoring the supervisor configuration copy. After the first Claude batch has been applied, an older Host still reads and applies the older kinds but refuses new Claude batches as invalid-request (observed in a throwaway rehearsal on a copied store), so rollback is forward-only for Claude data and the seals no longer describe the live stores. Keep the seals, the old payload and the configuration copy for a window the owner sets; deleting them is a separate admission. Credentials load only when the receiver starts, which is why enrollment and configuration edits need a restart (the recipe in docs/coordination is canonical for that).
title: Cutting a live receiver to a new Host changes only the program path; rollback to the old Host stops accepting the new Claude kind once it has written
